explication: ai-memory is a cross-agent, cross-machine long-term memory system for coding agents. Its central workflow captures sanitized lifecycle observations, consolidates session activity into a git-backed Markdown wiki, then supplies bounded briefs and search to later sessions; typed handoffs let agents pass work explicitly. The graph also preserves documented management, SDK, import, and optional LLM capabilities. Some subsystem wiring is documented only at product level, so those edges cite the README rather than implying unsampled call paths.
